ADVERSARIAL RESULT for W07-03 candidate 9459202d (branch devin/pp/w07-03/impl-r1). Attack branch devin/pp/w07-03/attack-9459202d @ 57aedb0f6a111d6a31f79a0a5aad67752641e4da (pushed, no PR) adds supabase/tests/w07_03_attack/run.sh + 9 SQL probes; candidate implementation and its tests untouched (only supabase/tests/w07_03_attack/ added). Harness: fresh postgres:16 DB, tests/shim_auth.sql, every migration in order, each probe in its own psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 run.

VERIFIED W07-03-AC1 on candidate: ./supabase/tests/run_rls_tests.sh exit 0, 4 histories x 4 suites = 16/16 PASS (artifact run_rls_tests.log, 'EXIT=0'). VERIFIED attack run on candidate: `W07_ATTACK_DB=w07_attack_r5 ./supabase/tests/w07_03_attack/run.sh` exit 1, executed=9 passed=4 failed=5 (attack_run_r5.log). VERIFIED base comparison (worktree at d8e5db3e + attack tests only): exit 1, executed=9 passed=1 failed=8 — 7 probes fail on base for the expected missing-schema reasons (api_private.billing_transfers / billing_transfer_recovery do not exist), attack_06 fails on base because no transfer lock exists, and attack_05 PASSES on base (source loss independent of the destination) but FAILS on the candidate => regression (attack_run_base.log).

CONFIRMED BREAKS (5): [P0] attack_02 — destination sync verdict applies while the transfer is pending, and in the held case both source and destination are premium (one purchase, two premium accounts) — directly contradicts 'destination gains only after provider confirmation' / AC2. [P1] attack_05 — destination without a profile row raises 23503 and rolls back the source loss; source keeps premium after a provider-confirmed loss (base passes). [P1] attack_01 — a destination shared by two unsettled transfers gets premium via the other transfer's ticket while the RPC returns withheld=true AND billing.premium=true. [P1] attack_03 — held source deleted from Auth never becomes 'missing'; transfer stays held, webhook 55000 forever. [P2] attack_04 cases 1-2 — overlapping or scalar transfer parties raise 22023 in begin_billing_verification (Edge => 503 => endless redelivery; base accepted them).

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (4, VERIFIED PASS on candidate): attack_06 concurrency (dblink second session; source-first and destination-first interleavings block on the transfer lock and finish without deadlock/error, held-release race, duplicate begin under one lease => one transfer row); attack_07 roles (anon/authenticated denied 42501 on the three api_private tables, the audit sequence, all public RPCs and every private helper; service_role allowed on the RPCs and denied direct table access; append-only guard blocks DELETE/UPDATE as superuser); attack_08 boundaries (17 subjects rejected 22023 with no durable rows, anonymous-only => no_subjects, far-future source expiry holds and far-past releases, stale older tickets neither demote the destination nor re-grant the source nor rewrite sides, conflicting re-enqueue 22023 / identical re-enqueue idempotent); attack_09 crash between steps (dead-lease completion 55000, redelivery re-verifies both sides, live-lease completion {received:true, verified:true}, audit sequence enqueued→destination_verified→destination_withheld→source_verified→destination_applied→confirmed).

Attack categories covered: concurrency/reentrancy + double submit (06), crash between steps / process death + stale lease (09), replay & duplicate identities (04, 08), boundary values incl. max subjects, anonymous-only, far-future/far-past clocks (08), corrupt/partial persisted state (01, 03, 05), unauthorised roles allowed+denied (07), poison-pill input shapes (04). Not applicable: free-rating conservation, copy/accessibility, Edge network failures (this package is SQL-only; Edge mapping stated as INFERRED). Per-run artifact paths in the checkout (gitignored): artifacts/w07-03-attack/{attack_run_r5.log,attack_run_base.log,run_rls_tests.log}; uploaded copies in attachment_urls.

T25b/T37b/T44b): API-only RLS + zero grants on api_private.billing_transfers/billing_transfer_sides/billing_transfer_audit (+ sequence); service-role-only SECURITY DEFINER RPCs with empty search_path; anon/authenticated denied; foreign/absent lease rejected; idempotent requeue; conflicting payload rejected; destination verdict WITHHELD (applied=false, withheld=true, billing.premium=false, no premium row) until source is provider-confirmed; withheld ticket still sealed; replay stays withheld; complete_billing_webhook refused before confirmation; recovery queue exposes unsettled transfer; source-inactive verdict releases destination at its own ticket order; source-first flow; retained source -> held, later source sync releases; absent source -> destination applies; malformed/overlapping/anonymous-only events; shipping path (begin_billing_verification alone queues TRANSFER, persist withholds, complete refused then succeeds; RENEWAL never queued); append-only audit / immutable settled history even for the table owner.
residual_risks: Held transfers (source still provider-active after a TRANSFER) keep the webhook retryable (503) until a later source verdict confirms loss; if RevenueCat stops redelivering, the transfer stays `held` in api_private.billing_transfers and is visible via public.billing_transfer_recovery(uuid), but no operator/UI surface consumes that RPC yet (Edge/index.ts is outside this package's serial groups).

A destination's OWN sync verdict (ticket not bound to the transfer event) is treated as direct provider confirmation and applies immediately — a deliberate design choice so a destination user is never blocked by webhook pipeline health; the transfer-bound barrier only governs verdicts issued for the TRANSFER event.

persist_billing_verdict's withheld response is a non-premium snapshot with applied=false; the Edge webhook handler (index.ts:3904-3919) treats outcome=persisted as success and relies on complete_billing_webhook raising 55000 to trigger RevenueCat redelivery — INFERRED from reading index.ts, not exercised end-to-end against Deno.

implement.summary:
GAP ON BASE_SHA (INFERRED from code): the webhook path supabase/functions/api/index.ts:3874-3923 (beginBillingVerification -> verifyRevenueCatSubscriber per subject -> persistBillingVerdict -> complete_billing_webhook) treats a TRANSFER's two subjects as independent verdicts. public.persist_billing_verdict (supabase/migrations/20260907133000_ordered_api_merge_integration.sql, the ordered upsert into public.billing_entitlements) grants the destination premium the moment its own RevenueCat verdict is persisted, regardless of whether the source has been provider-confirmed as no longer entitled; nothing durable records the transfer scope, so a crash between the two persists leaves a half-applied transfer with no recovery record, and complete_billing_webhook (same file) only checks per-ticket completion, not source/destination reconciliation. No transfer queue or audit ledger existed (regression on BASE aborts at security_regression.sql:5514: relation api_private.billing_transfers does not exist).

FIX (new forward migration supabase/migrations/20260908150000_billing_recovery_transfer.sql, timestamp later than every existing one; no applied migration edited):
- Durable queue: api_private.billing_transfers (event_id unique, payload_hash bound to the webhook claim hash, source/destination uuid[] scope, state pending|held|confirmed, settled_at), api_private.billing_transfer_sides (per-subject role, ticket_id, verification_order, verdict, verified_at, applied_at, user_missing_at), api_private.billing_transfer_audit (identity id, action enum, jsonb detail). RLS enabled, no policies, ALL table+sequence privileges revoked from public/anon/authenticated/service_role -> reachable only via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
- Append-only: trigger api_private.guard_billing_transfer_history rejects DELETE everywhere and UPDATE on the audit (insufficient_privilege), rejects re-scoping a transfer, reopening a confirmed transfer, rewriting an applied side or regressing a side's verification_order (check_violation) — enforced even for the table owner (tested as superuser).
- public.enqueue_billing_transfer(text,jsonb,uuid) [service_role only]: validates TRANSFER shape, normalises/dedupes uuid subjects (anonymous ids ignored), rejects source/destination overlap and >16 subjects (22023), requires the caller's live webhook lease (55000 otherwise), idempotent per event_id, rejects a different payload for the same event (22023), records missing Auth users, then settles.
- public.billing_transfer_recovery(uuid) [service_role only]: unsettled transfers for a subject with per-side verified/active/applied/missing flags.
- WIRING into the shipping path without touching supabase/functions/api/index.ts (edge-index serial group not held): public.begin_billing_verification(uuid[],text,jsonb,uuid) keeps its exact contract and additionally calls enqueue_billing_transfer when payload.event.type = 'TRANSFER' under the same lease; public.persist_billing_verdict(uuid,uuid,jsonb) keeps its exact contract/return shape and reconciles against the queue: a SOURCE verdict applies immediately (source loses) and is recorded on every unsettled transfer where the user is a source; a DESTINATION verdict issued for the transfer event is recorded but its premium grant is WITHHELD until every source side is provider-confirmed inactive or authoritatively absent from Auth (barrier = api_private.settle_billing_transfer). While withheld the RPC returns applied=false, withheld=true, billing.premium=false (+transfer {id,event_id,state}), so complete_billing_webhook (unchanged: requires an entitlement row at >= the ticket's order) raises 55000 and the Edge returns 503 -> RevenueCat redelivers; on redelivery new tickets re-verify both sides and the barrier releases once the source is confirmed lost. A source that still holds the entitlement parks the transfer as `held` (never fabricates loss or gain). Destination application goes through the same ordered upsert (newest verification_order wins). A verdict the destination obtains on its own (sync, not bound to the transfer event) is provider confirmation in its own right and applies directly while still being recorded/settled on the queue.
